lines.text: After Nebuchadnezzar carried Jeconiah off to Babylon, the LORD showed Jeremiah two baskets of figs in front of the temple.
One basket held very good figs and the other held very bad figs that could not be eaten.
The LORD called the exiles from Judah good figs, sent them to the land of the Egyptians, and promised to return them.
The LORD said He would deal with Zedekiah, his officials, and those living in the land of Moab like the bad figs.
The LORD said He would send sword, famine, and plague until they had perished from the land He gave them and their fathers.
